title: Templates pages keep ?lang= on every local link, offer six languages in the picker, and use formal address in es, it, nl
steps: S1: Run the tracy-web Templates and web-languages tests: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/public-templates-page.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/web-languages.test.mjs.
expect: S1: every test passes, including the gallery with ?lang=de and the detail page with ?lang=fr carrying the language on every local link, clean links without ?lang= or with an unknown one, and a picker of exactly en, de, fr, es, it, nl.
evidence: Before this change, following a card or menu link from tracy.ai/templates/?lang=de landed on English, the picker offered Vietnamese and Chinese, and es/it/nl strings used informal address.
